subject: License-flex assessment & phased cutover proposal for CS stack
message_1_subject: License-flex assessment & phased cutover proposal for CS stack
message_1_body:
Team —

We need to finalize a recommended licensing and cutover approach for our CS stack by end of next week. Goal: reduce per-ticket token costs and improve agent velocity while keeping enterprise SLAs intact. High-level options on the table:

1) Full consolidation: move all support to Intercom (chat + ticketing via Inbox) + Gainsight for CS motions.
2) Hybrid: Intercom for self-serve & SME chat; Zendesk retained for enterprise ticket routing and escalations.
3) Zendesk-first: migrate to Zendesk as primary with Gainsight integration; Intercom for marketing chat only.

Key variables: seat vs concurrent vs usage credits, data retention differences, migration effort (tickets & macros), and Gainsight seat bundling. Please focus on license economics and migration risk.

Asks: 
- Marissa: lead vendor negotiation calls (Intercom/Zendesk/Gainsight).
- Ben: model TCO + procurement terms and target PO cadence.
- Vanessa: draft phased cutover timeline + impact to CS org (training, routing).
- Mina: run historical usage delta (concurrent users, peak chat rates) and validate assumptions in cs_license_model_v1.xlsx (attached).

Timeline: vendor proposals by Friday 4/17; recommendation by 4/21. I've attached cs_license_model_v1.xlsx and a short vendor_questions.pdf to use in vendor calls.

Thanks — matteo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

message_3_subject: Intercom: Pilot credits proposal and flexible seat options
message_3_body:

- Pilot credits: 10k conversation-credits (apply to chat + inbox) to validate routing and macros over 60 days.
- Pricing: per-seat model for Inbox agents; option to add overflow concurrent credits billed monthly.
- Multi-year discount of 12% available for a 24-month commitment.

message_4_subject: Zendesk: Concurrent licensing + migration bundle proposal
message_4_body:
Hi Mateo / Marissa —

Following our demo, attached is an SKU-level proposal for a concurrent-user model that many of our enterprise customers prefer for variable agent coverage. Highlights: 

- Concurrent license pool sized to peak 90th percentile usage (we recommend a 10% buffer).
- Migration bundle: 80 hours of admin migration + 30 hours of playbook engineering.
- Integration: Gainsight connector certified; support for macro translation scripts.
- Quote includes a 10% discount for a 12-month commitment, or 15% for 24 months if bundled with professional services.

I'll leave the proposal attached (zendesk-proposal-Apr2027.pdf). If you want, we can prepare a short TCO comparison vs Intercom credits.

Regards,
Emma Li

emma.li@zendesk.com

message_5_subject: Procurement summary & recommendation: hybrid phased approach
message_5_body:
Team —

I ran the models against historical usage (see procurement_summary.xlsx attached). Short summary:

- Full consolidation to Intercom looks slightly cheaper over a 36-month horizon if agent headcount stays flat, but migration risk (enterprise ticketing rules, reporting) is non-trivial and would require 120+ migration hours.
- Zendesk concurrent pool reduces peak-seat cost but increases monthly ops complexity and requires custom routing work.
- Gainsight expansion seats are relatively inexpensive and provide immediate value for CS health automation.

Recommendation: Hybrid phased approach — pilot Intercom for chat and self-serve (60-day credits), expand Gainsight seats now, and keep Zendesk as the dedicated enterprise ticketing system for a 9-month runway while we port macros and SLAs. That reduces risk, keeps a path to consolidation, and buys time to prove Intercom's credits model at scale.

Please loop legal on SOW terms (I flagged areas around data exports, retention SLAs, and PO schedule).

Ben
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement_summary.xlsx
message_6_subject: Decision: Proceed with phased hybrid cutover (Intercom pilot + Gainsight expansion)
message_6_body:
Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the modeling work. I agree with Ben's recommendation. Decision and next steps: 

1) Approve Intercom pilot (activate 10k conversation credits) and execute Intercom pilot SOW — Marissa to lead vendor ops and accept via DocuSign if terms match proposal.
2) Expand Gainsight seats immediately (Ben to issue PO for the expansion seat bundle).
3) Zendesk retained for enterprise ticketing for a 9-month runway; Vanessa will own a cutover backlog and timeline (deliverable: cutover playbook v1 by 5/12).
4) Legal (cc'd) — start SOW review for Intercom & Gainsight; prioritize data export and retention clauses, and confirm indemnity language.
5) Finance (cc'd) — hold a PO slot for the Intercom pilot and Gainsight seat expansion; Ben will share numbers.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync Thursday to review SOW redlines and the cutover playbook.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
